title: Michael Aquino's ceremony at Wewelsburg Castle

tellings.quote: he conducted a ceremony at Vavsburg Castle, you know, the the Nazi SS Castle, some sort of satanic ceremony.

plain: A man named Michael Aquino is said to have held some kind of satanic ceremony in the 1980s at Wewelsburg Castle in Germany, the castle used by the SS, the Nazi elite guard. The researcher Peter Levenda tells this himself, pointing to a book called Unholy Alliance. It is told as a sign of a link between modern occult groups and Nazi ritual sites.
